title: DashboardCard

id.description: ID of the card (null for an automatically generated card on a dashboard that has not been customized yet; cards receive IDs the first time the dashboard is updated via the API or web app)

type.description:
Type of the card:

 - `messages_chart`: time series chart of messages sent and received
 - `contacts_chart`: time series chart of the number of contacts
 - `airtime_chart`: time series chart of airtime transactions
 - `data_table_chart`: time series chart of the number of rows in data tables
 - `data_table_summary`: pie or bar chart of the number of rows in a data table by the value of a particular field
 - `messages`: statistics about messages (e.g. number of messages sent and received today)
 - `contacts`: statistics about contacts (e.g. number of contacts in particular groups)
 - `data_tables`: statistics about data tables (e.g. number of rows in particular tables)
 - `airtime`: statistics about airtime/value transfers
 - `campaigns`: summary of recent, upcoming, and ongoing campaigns
 - `campaign_calendar`: calendar of sent and scheduled campaigns
 - `phones`: list of routes and their current status
 - `services`: list of active services
 - `poll`: charts of responses for each question in a poll
 - `account`: basic account information for the organization
 - `custom`: custom card with links
 - `setup`: project setup progress (automatically generated; cannot be added)

title.description: Title of the card. If no title has been set, a default title is displayed based on the card type.

order.description: Sort order of the card on the dashboard (cards are displayed in ascending order)

width.description: Width of the card in pixels, or null if the card has not been resized

height.description: Height of the card in pixels, or null if the card has not been resized

config.description:
Type-specific configuration parameters for the card. Only returned when retrieving a single card by ID or querying the cards on a dashboard. When updating a card, parameters omitted from `config` keep their current values. **messages card** Parameter Description - value_stats - Array of the statistics displayed on the card, in display order. Each item is an object with a type (see below) and, for statistic types that take parameters, a params object. - links - Array of shortcut links displayed on the card. Each item is an object with a type and, for link types that take parameters, a params object. Available link types: messages.new, messages.export, messages.stats, custom (see Links below). Available `value_stats` types for the `messages` card: Type Statistic Params - messages.todaycounts - Messages sent and received today by type (expands to multiple statistics, one for each direction/type combination) - - messages.scheduled - Scheduled messages - - messages.scheduledtoday - Messages scheduled for today - - messages.convtoday - Conversations today - - messages.activeconv - Active conversations - - messages.starred - Starred messages - - messages.broadcaststoday - Broadcasts sent today - - messages.status - All messages with a particular status - status: queued, failed, not_delivered, etc. - messages.statustoday - Messages today with a particular status - status: failed, not_delivered, service_error, etc. - messages.labelcount - Messages with a particular label - label_id: ID of the label **contacts card** Parameter Description - value_stats - Array of the statistics displayed on the card, in display order. Each item is an object with a type (see below) and, for statistic types that take parameters, a params object. - links - Array of shortcut links displayed on the card. Each item is an object with a type and, for link types that take parameters, a params object. Available link types: contacts.add, contacts.import, contacts.export, custom (see Links below). Available `value_stats` types for the `contacts` card: Type Statistic Params - contacts.total - Total number of contacts - - contacts.incomingtoday - Contacts heard from today - - contacts.outgoingtoday - Contacts contacted today - - contacts.createdtoday - Contacts created today - - contacts.groupmembers - Contacts in a particular group - group_id: ID of the group - contacts.viewcount - Contacts matching custom filters - title: displayed title; filters: object of conditions that contacts must match, in the same format as the filters of a dynamic group (see [project.createGroup](#Project.createGroup)) **data_tables card** Parameter Description - value_stats - Array of the statistics displayed on the card, in display order. Each item is an object with a type (see below) and, for statistic types that take parameters, a params object. - links - Array of shortcut links displayed on the card. Each item is an object with a type and, for link types that take parameters, a params object. Available link types: datatables.add, custom (see Links below). Available `value_stats` types for the `data_tables` card: Type Statistic Params - tables.recentlyupdated - Rows in recently updated data tables (expands to multiple statistics, one for each of the 5 most recently-updated data tables) - - tables.rows - Rows in a particular data table - table_id: ID of the data table - tables.viewrows - Rows in a particular data table view - view_id: ID of the data table view; title: displayed title **airtime card** Parameter Description - value_stats - Array of the statistics displayed on the card, in display order. Each item is an object with a type (see below) and, for statistic types that take parameters, a params object. - links - Array of shortcut links displayed on the card. Each item is an object with a type and, for link types that take parameters, a params object. Available link types: airtime.send, airtime.stats, custom (see Links below). Available `value_stats` types for the `airtime` card: Type Statistic Params - airtime.txtoday - Airtime transactions today - - airtime.spenttoday - Airtime spent today - - airtime.balance - Current balance with airtime providers - **messages_chart card** Parameter Description - statistic - Value to chart: count (number of messages), num_parts (number of SMS parts), duration (call duration), or price.<currency> (total price of messages in a particular currency, e.g. price.USD, where <currency> is a 3-letter ISO currency code in which messages in the project have been priced) - group_ids - Array of series group IDs determining how messages are grouped into chart series: type, direction, status, source, simulated, gateway, network, currency, link, user, phone, service - filters - Object of filter conditions on the messages included in the chart, e.g. {"dir": "incoming", "type": "sms"}. Each key is the filter parameter for a group that must be included in group_ids: type (message type, e.g. sms, call), dir (incoming or outgoing), status (message status, e.g. sent, delivered, failed), source (e.g. phone, web, api, service), simulated (bool), gateway (gateway ID), mccmnc (mobile network code), currency, link (clicked, not_clicked, or no_link), user, phone, service (IDs). Each value is a single value or an array of values to match. - rollup - Time period per data point: day, week, month, or year - date_range_mode - recent (the most recent prev_days days) or fixed (from start_date to end_date) - prev_days - Number of days to display when date_range_mode is recent (int) - start_date - First date to display (YYYY-MM-DD) when date_range_mode is fixed - end_date - Last date to display (YYYY-MM-DD) when date_range_mode is fixed - cumulative - If true, each data point shows the cumulative total up to that date (bool) **airtime_chart card** Parameter Description - statistic - Value to chart: count (number of successful transactions), topup_value.<currency> (total value transferred, e.g. topup_value.KES), or price.<currency> (total price of transactions, e.g. price.USD), where <currency> is a 3-letter ISO currency code in which transactions in the project have been valued or priced - group_ids - Array of series group IDs: airtime.billing, airtime.status, airtime.country, airtime.productid, airtime.category - filters - Object of filter conditions on the transactions included in the chart. Each key is the filter parameter for a group that must be included in group_ids: internal_billing (bool), status (e.g. successful, failed, cancelled), country (country code), product_id, provider_category. Each value is a single value or an array of values to match. - rollup - Time period per data point: day, week, month, or year - date_range_mode - recent (the most recent prev_days days) or fixed (from start_date to end_date) - prev_days - Number of days to display when date_range_mode is recent (int) - start_date - First date to display (YYYY-MM-DD) when date_range_mode is fixed - end_date - Last date to display (YYYY-MM-DD) when date_range_mode is fixed - cumulative - If true, each data point shows the cumulative total up to that date (bool) **contacts_chart card** Parameter Description - series - Array of up to 10 data series to chart (the same keys as the series parameter of [project.getContactStats](#Project.getContactStats)): each item is either total (the total number of contacts in the project) or the ID of a contact group (the number of contacts in that group) - rollup - Time period per data point: day, week, month, or year - date_range_mode - recent (the most recent prev_days days) or fixed (from start_date to end_date) - prev_days - Number of days to display when date_range_mode is recent (int) - start_date - First date to display (YYYY-MM-DD) when date_range_mode is fixed - end_date - Last date to display (YYYY-MM-DD) when date_range_mode is fixed - cumulative - If true, each data point shows the cumulative total up to that date (bool) **data_table_chart card** Parameter Description - series - Array of up to 10 data series to chart (the same keys as the series parameter of [project.getDataTableStats](#Project.getDataTableStats)): each item is the ID of a data table or data table view (the number of rows in that table or view) - rollup - Time period per data point: day, week, month, or year - date_range_mode - recent (the most recent prev_days days) or fixed (from start_date to end_date) - prev_days - Number of days to display when date_range_mode is recent (int) - start_date - First date to display (YYYY-MM-DD) when date_range_mode is fixed - end_date - Last date to display (YYYY-MM-DD) when date_range_mode is fixed - cumulative - If true, each data point shows the cumulative total up to that date (bool) **data_table_summary card** Parameter Description - table_id - ID of the data table - stats_variable - The custom variable (field) of the data table to count rows by, e.g. region (without the vars. prefix used in filters) - chart_type - pie or bar - sort - Sort order of the values: count (by number of rows) or value - num_values - Maximum number of values to display (int) - filters - Object of conditions that rows must match to be counted. To filter by a custom variable (field) of the table, precede the field name with vars. (e.g. {"vars.region": "North"}); other supported keys are view (ID of a data table view whose rows should be counted), id, contact_id, contact_name, from_number, time_created, and time_updated. Each value is either a value to match exactly, or an object with an operator such as ne, prefix, gte, lt, exists, or not_exists as the key (e.g. {"vars.age": {"gte": 18}}). **poll card** Parameter Description - service_id - ID of the poll service - chart_type - pie, bar, or none **campaign_calendar card** Parameter Description - period - month, week, or day - status - Only display campaigns with this status: draft, scheduled, sent, or pending_review (null to display all campaigns) **campaigns card** Parameter Description - links - Array of shortcut links displayed on the card. Each item is an object with a type and, for link types that take parameters, a params object. Available link types: campaigns.new, custom (see Links below). **services card** Parameter Description - filters - Object of filter conditions for the services displayed on the card: trigger (incoming_message, manual, recurring, message_action, contact_action, outgoing_call, message_status, link, data_row_action, project_action, or webhook), template (bool; if true, only display custom templates), tag (only display services with this tag) - links - Array of shortcut links displayed on the card. Each item is an object with a type and, for link types that take parameters, a params object. Available link types: services.add, custom (see Links below). **phones card** Parameter Description - links - Array of shortcut links displayed on the card. Each item is an object with a type and, for link types that take parameters, a params object. Available link types: phones.add, phones.routes, custom (see Links below). **account card** Parameter Description - links - Array of shortcut links displayed on the card. Each item is an object with a type and, for link types that take parameters, a params object. Available link types: account.billing, account.users, account.api, custom (see Links below). **custom card** Parameter Description - links - Array of shortcut links displayed on the card. Each item is an object with a type and, for link types that take parameters, a params object. Available link types: custom (see Links below). **Links** Link types other than `custom` take no parameters. A `custom` link has the following `params`: Param Description - title - Displayed link text - link_type - Determines how url_suffix is interpreted: project_relative (default), account_relative, user_relative, or external (see below) - url_suffix - The link destination, whose format depends on link_type:
- project_relative: a path relative to the project's URL in the Telerivet web app (e.g. messages or contacts?f[group]=CG2ad0100821a98bea links to https://telerivet.com/p/<project url_slug>/messages or .../contacts?...)
- account_relative: a path relative to the organization's URL in the web app (https://telerivet.com/a/<organization id>/), e.g. billing
- user_relative: a path relative to the URL of the user viewing the dashboard (https://telerivet.com/u/<username>/), e.g. settings
- external: an absolute URL, e.g. https://example.com/report - open_in_new_tab - If true, the link opens in a new browser tab (bool)

dashboard_id.description: ID of the dashboard this card belongs to

project_id.description: ID of the project this card belongs to

time_created.description: Time the card was created in Telerivet (null for an automatically generated card on a dashboard that has not been customized)

time_updated.description: Time the card was last updated in Telerivet

description:
Represents a card on a dashboard, displaying a statistic, chart, or summary of objects within a project.

 Each card has a `type` along with a type-specific `config` object controlling what the card displays.
